english:
Summons a 3-shot <solar Golden Gun /> that grants <pve 60% /> <pvp [0%] /> Damage Resistance. Lasts 12 seconds, draining 8.34% Super Energy per second. <solar Knock 'Em Down /> extends the duration to 16 seconds and decreases the drain to 6.25% per second.

Each shot deals <pve 1,574 /> <pvp [426] /> damage and applies 40 stacks of <solar Scorch />. Precision Hits deal 200% of normal damage. Shots benefit from <solar Radiant />'s damage increase.

Precision Hits grant a stack of 'Line'Em Up' and spawn 2 Orbs of Power. Maximum of 2 stacks, lasting until the Super ends.

Line'Em Up grants the following benefits at 1|2 stacks:
• 45.8%|90% increased damage
• 25?%|50?% decreased passive Super Energy drain

Orbs from Precision Hits grant Super Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Non-Boss Combatants: 3.57%
• Bosses: 2.85%
• Bosses with <yellow Star-Eater Scales />: 2.5%

// Source lists Scorch as x40+10; the enhancement granting the additional 10 stacks is not identified.
